page.layout: One text column in the centre with marginal notes in the right margin (Ver.17, Ver.20, and a small Hebrew-letter note). Running head and page number at the top. Faint show-through from the reverse side throughout, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: momentosum esse, quod dicit Fagius, obscurari promissionem, quam Deus hic Ecclesiae suae promittit, cuius typum gerit Sara. Hunc igitur locum, tanquam censum suum haud dignum, praetermisit Amama.

Et risit. ] Chald. [?], i.e. & laetatus est. R. Salom. hanc expositionem probat, atque addit Abrahami risum ex fide, Sarae autem ex incredulitate provenisse; ac propterea Saram reprehensam fuisse, non autem Abrahamum. Jonath. & Hierosolymitanus [illegible, ~12 letters] admirans est. Ver.17.

Num centenario nascetur filius? ] Ad verb. filio [illegible, ~6 letters] annorum. Sic ibidem Sara vocatur filia 90 annorum, [illegible, ~8 letters] nonagenaria. Ita passim phrasis ista usurpatur. Lyra recte notat, Abrahamum hoc dixisse, non dubitando, sed divinum beneficium admirando. R. Salom. notat, priorum seculo hominem quingentorum annorum filios procreasse; ac tandem Abrahamum hominibus vetustam adeo fuisse decrepitum, ut communi [illegible, ~5 letters] generare esset pro miraculo.

ob [illegible, ~4 letters] Ipsa [illegible, ~3 letters] hoc (inquit Lyra) dicant Hebraei, & [illegible, ~4 letters] videtur, quod [illegible, ~5 letters] sua in bono; quia de hoc Abraham rogaverat ipsum Deum (Sic interpretantur illud [illegible, ~6 letters]) [illegible, ~10 letters] coram te, ut faciens voluntatem & beneplacitum tuum. ) Vide ad cap. [illegible, ~8 letters] Ver.20.

tempore duos angelos (duos fuisse ex [illegible, ~12 letters]) [illegible, ~6 letters] in isto ipso. ] Sic vehebat. Non dubitabat esse Abraham Dei immutabilem exequi ut hoc Abeni Ezra. Nec intepe idem hinc [illegible, ~10 letters] servos Abrahami, qui [illegible, ~4 letters] circumcisi, omnesque eo ipso die circumcisi, non ab eo fuisse coacti, sed volentes, lubentesque ad Dei mandatum peragendum festinasse. R. Salom. hic argumentum [illegible, ~4 letters] ut

page.notes: Heavy show-through and smudging from the reverse side make most of the lines in the middle and lower page unreadable; the bracketed passages mark where I could not read the letters with confidence. The Hebrew/Chaldee word after "Chald." and the small marginal Hebrew note ("Ver.17" area) are not legible enough to copy. Bottom-left marginal text ("Abrahamum" faint) is show-through and was left out. Catchword "ut" at lower right is a doubtful reading.
